label: C2701_V8_TAF_SOURCE_CORRECTION_AND_COHERENT_MODEL
fit_and_calibration: Same dates, sampling, timing cutoff, thresholds and regularization as VALIDATION_V7.json. For the coherent candidate, branch-specific sampling and calibration are paired between the schedule and weather variants.
source_policy: Recover exact station and AWIPS/WMO product identity. Only initial and FM are prevailing. Do not import probabilistic, temporary or becoming conditions. Refit and recalibrate after feature corrections. Preserve archived v7 inputs and result files.
sensitivity_policy: Keep text-supported archive-wide variable-wind amendments separate from exact full-bulletin corrections. Compare outcome-independent traceable field semantics. Preserve matching keys and evaluate paired identities.
comparisons: Original binary TAF and exact-source-corrected binary TAF, paired to the same schedule-proxy comparison
Corrected matched schedule-proxy and corrected matched TAF, shared five-leaf product distributions
Text-supported variable-wind sensitivity kept separate from the exact-source result
evaluation: Report Brier and log loss for both cumulative thresholds. Diagnose bias, adverse group and missing matches. Verify five leaves are nonnegative, sum to one, and P60 <= P15; retain zero-inversion claims as empirical for separate binary fits only. Use date-block ranges descriptively, with unchanged v7 day boundaries.
prospective_readout: Use currently unavailable BTS Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance months after September. Score the implemented pre-specified candidates for every outcome month that becomes available, with coverage and missingness. Do not tune on these outcomes or add them to fitting. Rebuild forecasts under the same as-of cutoff with versioned TAF inputs. Report by month and pooled, keeping both thresholds, adverse-weather calibration, and the known limitations visible. Use schedule-only predictions as a paired fallback where TAF is unavailable. Promotion requires separate review of calibration, 60-minute Brier and prospective support, plus actual versioned schedule and receipt timestamps for operational use.
